cues: Take logs: ln k equals ln A minus E a over R, times one over T.
Plot ln k against one over T, and the slope gives you minus E a over R.
That is how activation energies are measured.
text: Take logs: ln k equals ln A minus E a over R, times one over T. That is a straight line. Plot ln k against one over T, and the slope gives you minus E a over R. That is how activation energies are measured.
